answer_1.quote: We evaluate on six high-quality datasets across three core VL tasks: VQAv2, VizWiz, and OK-VQA for open-ended VQA; Flickr30K and MSCOCO for captioning; and HatefulMemes for classification.

answer_2.quote: For the VQA tasks, Hybrid dataset and tasks in VL-ICL Bench, we use accuracy as the metric ... CIDEr (Vedantam et al., 2015) is used for image captioning datasets (Flickr30k, MSCOCO). ROC-AUC is used for the HatefulMemes classification task.
